plan_area_inventory.title: Stop delivering framework README to repo root; canonical framework surface is its_magic/README.md only (complete US-0062 / DEC-0045)
Bootstrap a project-owned root README scaffold on first project story when missing or still framework placeholder
Mandatory execute/release steps that create and extend project README on each shipped user story or sprint
Project README structure with user-facing repo overview plus developer orientation sections
Separate validators/gates: framework feature catalog (US-0091) vs project backlog coverage in root README
Upgrade/missing install paths that lift legacy framework README out of root without destroying operator project prose
Phase commands, runbook, installer manifest, validators, contract tests, and template parity for project README contract

topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: When I start a new project with its-magic, the root README is still the huge its-magic framework catalog. I want a project-specific repo overview for users and developers that is created on first story and extended every sprint — that behavior does not happen today.
Downstream repos after its-magic install (missing/upgrade modes); Cursor slash-command lifecycle through execute and release when shipping project user stories from docs/product/backlog.md.

Project-owned Markdown at repo root README.md; framework docs confined to its_magic/README.md; Python stdlib validators; installer-owned-paths.manifest and phase command contracts in .cursor/commands/.

Finish the US-0062 split: framework README must not be shipped to root; root README is project-owned. Wire per-story README bootstrap and sprint deltas into execute/release with a blocking gate — not only the optional US-0032 user-guide path.

Root README opens with the project name and purpose, then user-facing what-it-does/how-to-run sections, plus a developer section for setup and repo layout; each shipped US-xxxx adds or updates a concise feature blurb in the catalog.

Project README prose remains subject to US-0071 user-visible metadata hygiene; upgrade must not silently delete operator-written project README content when lifting legacy framework copy to its_magic/.

Fail-closed when a shipped user-visible project story lacks a detectable README anchor; separate framework US-0091 coverage (its-magic features) from project backlog coverage; default-on behavior for new installs without manual README chores each sprint.

Single story US-0097 in tranches: A installer boundary + migration, B project README bootstrap scaffold, C execute/release mandatory deltas, D project README validator and gate separation from framework README family.
